verdict.rationale: Medusa maintains complete OpenAPI 3.0 specs powering an api-reference site (medusa-gh-x1), which typically includes interactive 'try it' functionality, but the probe found no discoverable openapi.json/swagger.json endpoint (medusa-probe-2) and no direct evidence of runnable/executable examples within the reference UI itself. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the API reference supports live 'try it out' execution, independent/hands-on corroboration of interactive examples working, and a working machine-discoverable OpenAPI endpoint.
